Oil crashed eleven percent today. Your stocks could win or lose. Here's who.
This morning, Brent crude fell as low as ninety three and a half dollars, from almost one hundred five dollars yesterday.
Why? The US midterm results favoured the Democrats, and markets now hope the West Asia conflict ends sooner.
Why does India care? Because nearly nine out of ten barrels of crude we use are imported.
Cheaper oil means a smaller import bill. So Indian stocks rallied. By eleven twenty, Sensex was up almost fifteen hundred points, and Nifty was up one point eight percent.
Now, who wins when oil falls?
One. Airlines. Fuel is a huge cost for them. IndiGo is up five percent.
Two. Paint makers. Many of their raw materials come from crude. Asian Paints is up four percent.
And who loses? Oil producers, because they earn less per barrel. ONGC is down two percent.
But careful. Even after today's fall, oil is still up eighteen percent in three months. One headline can flip it back.
Save this, so the next time oil moves, you know who wins and who loses. Follow money in cloud for more.
